description: Tell LayerHop that the user's wallet broadcast the transaction for a quoteId, so the order is tracked (status, webhooks). Call this once after broadcasting, with the EVM tx hash (0x + 64 hex) or Solana signature. Idempotent. Does not sign or send anything.

quoteId.description: quoteId from get_quote (starts with "q_"). Quotes expire after a short time (see expiresAt).

txHash.description: Source-chain transaction hash (EVM 0x...) or Solana signature (base58).

name: report_submitted
title: Report a broadcast transaction
